description:
OPTIONAL - at the END of a deploy OR a version UPGRADE, offer to help improve Zoxron MCP by
    sending an ANONYMOUS, structured summary of THIS case. Only ever ask the user once, after
    `summary`, and only send if they say yes. There is NO free-text and NO identifying data: it
    carries only edition, odoo_major, the app names, the workflow (tool names in order), per-step
    outcomes (ok + a failure_class enum), any dependency resolutions (module→package), coarse
    timings, an optional 1-5 rating, and - for an upgrade - a `migration` trace. It NEVER sends
    host/IP/domain/db name/client/paths/keys/the Enterprise contract - the server drops anything
    that isn't a recognised token.

    You (the agent) fill these from what you just did:
      edition: "community"|"enterprise"; odoo_major: e.g. 18
      apps: ["crm","sale"]; workflow: ["host_enroll","base_provision","app_install","go_live"]
      outcomes: [{"step":"app_install","ok":true,"failure_class":null}]
      deps: [{"module":"phonenumbers","pkg":"python3-phonenumbers","manager":"apt"}]
      timings: {"provision":42,"install":190}; rating: 1-5 (optional).

    **`migration` - IMPORTANT for version upgrades that carried non-core add-ons across.** Record
    what actually happened per add-on, INCLUDING the fixes YOU (the agent) had to apply by hand that
    the tool could not auto-fix - that is exactly the signal that teaches the tool and makes the next
    person's upgrade smoother:
      migration: {"from_major":17, "to_major":19, "edition":"community", "data_verify":"zero_loss",
        "addons":[{"module":"sale_order_type", "port_class":"assist", "outcome":"data_ok",
                   "breaks":["tree_view_renamed","comodel_stock_route_renamed"],
                   "agent_fixed":["comodel_stock_route_renamed"],   # what YOU fixed, not the tool
                   "unknown_breaks":["some_new_break_slug"]}]}      # NEW breaks you tagged (a slug, not prose)
    `breaks`/`agent_fixed`/`unknown_breaks` are short snake_case tags only (catalogue keys from
    addon_migrate_assess, or a slug you coin for a NEW break) - never sentences.
    For a FULL-HISTORY migration (data_pump_*) add `"pump": {"verdict": "ok|problems|incomplete|
    not_verified", "gotchas_hit": [gotcha keys from data_pump_plan], "not_covered_hit": [...],
    "stages_failed": [...], "agent_fixed": [slugs], "iterations": N}` - keys only, never data.

    **`agent_assists` - the GENERAL version of that signal, for ANY operation (not just upgrades).**
    Whenever a tool couldn't do something and YOU stepped in to make it work, note it - that is how the
    tool's gaps get found and closed:
      agent_assists: [{"area":"tls_setup", "reason":"cf_origin_cert_manual", "fixed":true}]
    `area` = the tool/phase, `reason` = a short slug (never prose), `fixed` = did your help resolve it.

    Two-step like every write: call once (dry_run) to PREVIEW the exact payload for the user, then
    again with confirm=true ONLY after they approve. Preview is content-bound - editing needs a fresh
    preview.
name: improve_share
